title: Model European conditional descriptor banks
changes: Add a strict lossless EUR model for 23 conditional descriptor pointers and 684 records, retaining original u8 address arithmetic and excluding bank0 and the bank22 gap.
validation: One isolated Windows build and one Wine filter passed all source bytes and shape/source guards, the original bank count dispatcher and unit-count stores, and in-range and out-of-projection descriptor getter cases.
limitations: The model is not yet published or consumed by the runtime; ordinary use, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
